comments.author: ShelZuuz
comments.body:
Those "price errors" are called arbitrage. 

This is totally a thing. But it's done by supercomputers sitting 100s of feet away from the stock exchange trading computers and investing millions of dollars getting trades to execute in the microsecond range before their competitors can pick it up. It's done in FPGA hardware. It's a whole arms-race.

The idea that this can be done by an LLM AI is ridiculous. By the time the first token has uploaded to the GPU, the trade is LONG gone.
